services.name: Turtle Town Sea Scooter Snorkeling Tour with Photos and Video
services.desc: Aloha and welcome! Join us on this exciting fully GUIDED sea scooter snorkeling tour of Turtle Town, one of the best snorkeling destinations on Maui. Local and experienced guides will guide you to navigate the waters, and point out the natural treasures of Turtle Town. We will also document your experience with an underwater camera as you explore the reefs and swim with turtles. Duration 1.5 hour What you will see: Hawaiian green sea turtles (GUARANTEED)! Nenue (lowfin chubs), goatfish, octopus, black surgeon, frogfish, parrotfish, and so much more. About: Get ready to experience the thrill of a lifetime at Turtle Town - a spot that promises to be a haven for endangered green sea turtles.
